app.feature.1.desc: Aikin ƙauna ne daga al’ummar MontageSubs. Mun saka ƙa’idoji, hanyoyin aiki da tsarin rubutu na masu yin rubutun fassara na sa-kai a cikin kayan aiki na kyauta, buɗaɗɗen tushe, wanda ba don riba aka yi shi ba. Ba ado, ba surutu: hanya ce mai sauƙi ta samun rubutun fassara mai kyan gani, mai santsin karatu.
app.feature.1.title: Kayan ƙwararru, na kowa da kowa
app.feature.2.desc: Rubutun fassara magana ce mai rai, ba jerin layuka daban-daban ba. Muna tsara yadda ake ba na’urar fassara rubutun, domin ta fahimci saurin fage da yadda tattaunawa ke tafiya. Tare da ƙamus da duba inganci, kalmomi suna zama iri ɗaya a duk fim ɗin, lokaci kuma yana daidai.
app.feature.2.title: Fage zuwa fage, ba layi zuwa layi ba
app.feature.3.desc: Babu shigarwa. Babu buɗe asusu. Babu talla, babu biyan kuɗi, babu bin diddigin mutane. Mun cire duk abin da ba shi da amfani. Kayan aiki ne mai sauƙi: ka kawo rubutun fassara, a fassara maka shi da sauri, cikin tsabta.
